meta.summary: AI spend governed at 8.9x sector median with team envelopes, agent kill switches, and shadow AI rerouting for a scaling ai_native seed company.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist or a team subscription is already active.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 82% consumed in a billing month
Team envelope reaches 100% consumed with 5 or more days remaining in the billing month
Company envelope reaches 110% consumed or any agent exceeds kill threshold

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day runs under the Engineering envelope and is tagged customer-facing-inference, correctly classified as COGS under the production environment rule.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 fall within the Data team envelope of $1,200/month and are classified OpEx as an internal pipeline run; no action required.
rationales.e3: A 96% cost-per-request increase with flat volume indicates a model routing change or prompt expansion in the deploy; this breaches the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope and triggers a step-1 alert for the team lead to investigate.
rationales.e4: Marketing has logged its third ChatGPT Team subscription this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 2; the charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI company contract and the employee card transaction is blocked per shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued; the approval checklist UI will capture the required sign-off.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit per task, and its $47/hr burn rate exceeds the $40/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build falls within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost delta is within the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval is required before routing is changed.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step-2 throttle under the response ladder; the Engineering lead is notified within 48 hours and usage is rate-limited until a valid project tag is applied.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a Sales-held contract at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the trial is rerouted.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the new_provider_rule; the transaction is flagged, the provider is blocked pending Engineering lead approval, and the vendor security questionnaire is initiated.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tooling was misclassified as COGS; the classification rule for project_tag internal-tooling overrides to OpEx and the transaction is corrected in the current period ledger.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; a step-1 alert is issued to team leads to pace discretionary usage for the remainder of the month.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup is within policy bounds across all active envelopes; no escalation required.
